summary: Sony Group Corp filed a Form 6-K attaching a Japanese share buyback report for June 1–30, 2026, under a board resolution on May 8, 2026, authorizing up to 230 million shares (¥500 billion max) through May 10, 2027. During the month it repurchased 18,006,700 shares for ¥60.2 billion (cumulative 37,076,600 shares for ¥127.5 billion, 16.12% of authorization). Dispositions were for stock compensation and exercise of stock acquisition rights. This is a routine open-market buyback reporting, not a tender offer or capital return event. No advisor, premium, or structural change noted. Watch for ongoing repurchase pace under the existing authority.
